lane.args.cardsMax.text: at most {max} cards in a lane
lane.args.cardsMax.note: cw_lane start's refusal: too many cards.

lane.args.cardsNone.text: cards must be the card numbers, in order (at least one)
lane.args.cardsNone.note: cw_lane start's refusal of its cards argument: none given, or not a list.

lane.args.cardsNumbers.note: cw_lane start's refusal: a card in cards isn't a whole card number.

lane.args.cardsRepeat.note: cw_lane start's refusal: a card is named twice.

lane.args.numberRange.note: cw_lane start's refusal of rounds or waitMinutes ({what}, the argument's name) out of range.

lane.card.blocked.note: A lane's card that is blocked, after its column in the lane's line ("#402 Doing (blocked)").

lane.card.round.note: A lane's card's review round, after its column in the lane's line ("#405 Review r2").

lane.change.earlierAbandoned.note: After a start's reply: the builder's earlier lane, sharing no card with the new list, was abandoned.

lane.change.earlierEnded.note: After a start's reply: the builder's earlier lane, sharing no card with the new list, ended (nothing of it left to do).

lane.change.joined.note: cw_lane join's reply; {line} is the lane's line.

lane.change.started.note: cw_lane start's reply for a new lane; {line} is the lane's line.

lane.change.updated.note: cw_lane start's reply for the builder's running lane, changed; {line} is the lane's line.

lane.column.doing.note: A card's column in a lane's line (a column name).

lane.column.done.note: A card's column in a lane's line (a column name).

lane.column.gone.note: A lane's card that is gone (deleted, archived, or in another project now), in the lane's line.

lane.column.hold.note: A card's column in a lane's line (a column name).

lane.column.passed.note: A card's column in a lane's line (a column name).

lane.column.review.note: A card's column in a lane's line (a column name).

lane.column.todo.note: A card's column in a lane's line (a column name).

lane.column.unrecorded.note: An ended lane's card with no record of where it was when the lane ended (#512), in the lane's line.

lane.end.abandoned.note: cw_lane end's reply for an abandoned lane; {line} is the lane's line.

lane.end.ended.note: cw_lane end's reply; {line} is the lane's line.

lane.join.first.text: {builder} hadn't registered it yet: its own start updates it.
lane.join.first.note: cw_lane join's note: the reviewer joined first, starting the lane from its cards; the builder's own start updates it.

lane.journal.fact.text: Lane {named, select, yes {"{name}" } other {}}{state, select, started {started} ended {ended} merged {ended, merged at {commit}} other {abandoned}}: {who}, {cards}
lane.journal.fact.note: A lane's start or end as a fact in the Assistant's journal (#1031), stored: {who} is "builder / reviewer", {cards} its cards; {named} yes when the lane has a name ({name}).

lane.line.named.note: A lane in one line, as lane.line.text, with the lane's own name ({name}).

lane.line.noReviewer.note: In place of {reviewer}: the lane has no reviewer yet.

lane.line.pair.note: A lane's builder and reviewer, and its project, at the start of its line.

lane.line.pairInSlot.note: A lane's builder and reviewer, its project and the slot its cards are built in (#1438), at the start of its line.

lane.line.pool.note: In place of {reviewer}: the lane is reviewed by the project's reviewer pool (#1443).

lane.line.text.note: A lane in one line, for the hive tools: "B1 / R1 (hive): active, on #405; #483 Passed, #405 Review r2; rounds 10, wait 6 h. lane-3fa2". {cards}: its cards, each "key column"; {id}: the lane's id.

lane.list.none.note: cw_lane list with all: there are no lanes.

lane.list.noneListed.text: No lanes running or recently ended.
lane.list.noneListed.note: cw_lane list: no lane is running or ended recently (an ended lane stays listed an hour).

lane.next.afterQueue.text: Next: {card}, once {n, plural, one {it is} other {they are}} Done.
lane.next.afterQueue.note: cw_lane next, after its passed cards' places in the merge queue (#1354): the next card waits for them to be Done (one card at a time); {n} is how many.

lane.next.allDone.text: Every card of the lane is Done or past review: nothing to start. The lane ends by itself once all are Done.
lane.next.allDone.note: cw_lane next, with no card left to start.

lane.next.carryOn.note: cw_lane next: the card in flight (Doing or Review) to carry on; {card} is its key and title; {also} is " (why the lane waits)" or nothing.

lane.next.carryOnIn.note: cw_lane next: the card in flight to carry on, in the slot its lane builds in (#1438); {also} as in lane.next.carryOn.

lane.next.nothingElse.text: Nothing else to start: the lane ends by itself once all are Done.
lane.next.nothingElse.note: cw_lane next, after its passed cards' places in the merge queue (#1354): no card is left to start.

lane.next.start.note: cw_lane next: the card to start next; {card} is its key and title.

lane.next.startIn.text: Next: {card}. Start it: it is built in {slot}, on a new branch Combwork makes there.
lane.next.startIn.note: cw_lane next: the card to start next, built in the lane's slot (#1438), where Hive makes its line as it starts.

lane.next.waits.text: The lane waits: {why}. Start nothing new meanwhile.
lane.next.waits.note: cw_lane next, for a paused lane (#1270): why it waits.

lane.refused.allDone.text: {cards} {n, plural, one {is} other {are}} already Done: no lane started.
lane.refused.allDone.note: cw_lane start refused: every card of its list is already Done; {n} is how many.

lane.refused.applyNow.changedMeanwhile.text: {card} was put back in Todo (its work stays on its branch), but the lane's list changed meanwhile: this list wasn't applied. cw_lane list shows it now.
lane.refused.applyNow.changedMeanwhile.note: A reorder applied now (HI-1995): its card was put back, then the lane's list changed before this one was saved.

lane.refused.applyNow.endedMeanwhile.text: {card} was put back in Todo (its work stays on its branch), but the lane was ended meanwhile: its list wasn't changed and nothing was started. cw_lane list shows the lanes.
lane.refused.applyNow.endedMeanwhile.note: A reorder applied now (HI-1995): its card was put back, then the lane ended before its list was saved.

lane.refused.applyNow.inATurn.text: {agent} {status, select, working {is working} starting {is starting} waiting {is waiting for the user} other {has background tasks running}}: a reorder applied now never puts its card back under it. Ask it to finish and end its turn, then reorder again.
lane.refused.applyNow.inATurn.note: A reorder applied now (HI-1995) refused: the builder is in a turn of its own ({status}: working, starting, waiting for the user, or background tasks running).

lane.refused.applyNow.inReview.text: {card} is in {where, select, review {Review} other {Approved or merging}}: putting it back would lose its review or merge. Change the order without applyNow (it applies once {card} is Done), or wait.
lane.refused.applyNow.inReview.note: A reorder applied now (HI-1995) refused: the builder's card in flight is in Review (where review) or Approved or merging.

lane.refused.applyNow.notPutBack.note: A reorder applied now (HI-1995) refused: putting the card in flight back was refused, with no reason given.

lane.refused.applyNow.uncommitted.text: {card}'s folder has changes that aren't committed: commit them first (or ask {agent} to), then reorder again, so its work stays on its branch.
lane.refused.applyNow.uncommitted.note: A reorder applied now (HI-1995) refused: the card in flight's folder has uncommitted changes.

lane.refused.end.abandon.text: Only the user or the Assistant abandons a lane: tell the user if it should stop
lane.refused.end.abandon.note: cw_lane end with abandoned refused (#1270, §16.8.2): an agent never abandons its lane.

lane.refused.end.movedOn.text: Its cards moved on meanwhile: read the lane again
lane.refused.end.movedOn.note: cw_lane end refused: the lane's cards moved between its read and its save (a card reopened).

lane.refused.end.notDone.text: The lane ends by itself once all its cards are Done: {cards} not yet
lane.refused.end.notDone.note: cw_lane end refused (#1270): an agent's lane ends by itself once all its cards are Done; {cards} are those not Done yet.

lane.refused.end.notOurs.text: Only a lane's builder or reviewer ends it (or the user, or the Assistant)
lane.refused.end.notOurs.note: cw_lane end refused: a project agent that isn't the lane's builder or reviewer.

lane.refused.generalist.text: {agent} is a generalist: it takes no side in the workflow, so it is never a lane's builder or reviewer. Choose a builder, a reviewer or an either-role agent.
lane.refused.generalist.note: cw_lane's refusal (HI-686): a generalist agent is never a lane's builder or reviewer.

lane.refused.joinNoLane.text: {builder} has no lane running yet: give the cards too, and the lane starts with you as its reviewer
lane.refused.joinNoLane.note: cw_lane join refused: the builder has no running lane, and no cards were given to start one.

lane.refused.joinPool.text: {builder}'s lane is reviewed by the reviewer pool: there is nothing to join. Combwork gives you its cards when it assigns them to you.
lane.refused.joinPool.note: cw_lane join refused (#1443): a lane reviewed by the pool has nobody to join it.

lane.refused.keptChanging.text: The lane kept changing: try again
lane.refused.keptChanging.note: cw_lane start refused: the lane's cards kept moving between its read and its save.

lane.refused.next.abandoned.text: Your lane {lane} was abandoned: don't start it again; ask the user if there is more to do.
lane.refused.next.abandoned.note: cw_lane next, for an agent whose lane was just abandoned (HI-2273).

lane.refused.next.ended.text: Your lane {lane} has ended: all its cards are Done. Nothing more on it: don't start it again; end your turn unless you have other work.
lane.refused.next.ended.note: cw_lane next, for an agent whose lane just ended (HI-2273): never "start one", which invited a builder to start it again.

lane.refused.next.none.text: No running lane of yours: start one with cw_lane start, or ask the user
lane.refused.next.none.note: cw_lane next, for an agent with no running lane.

lane.refused.noLaneToPlace.text: {builder} has no running lane in {project}: the card was made but not placed. Start one with cw_lane start (its key is in this reply), or pass lane as '{ builder, reviewer }' to start one as you create a card.
lane.refused.noLaneToPlace.note: cw_create_task's lane refused (HI-2167): the builder named has no running lane to place the card on. '{ builder, reviewer }' is quoted ICU: it shows as { builder, reviewer }.

lane.refused.poolReviewer.text: A lane reviewed by the pool has no reviewer of its own
lane.refused.poolReviewer.note: cw_lane start refused: a reviewer named for a lane reviewed by the pool (#1443).

lane.refused.selfReview.text: A lane's builder can't be its reviewer
lane.refused.selfReview.note: cw_lane start or join refused: the same agent named as builder and reviewer.

lane.refused.unknownBuilder.text: Unknown agent: the builder must be an agent of the project
lane.refused.unknownBuilder.note: cw_lane start refused: its builder isn't an agent of the project.

lane.refused.unknownPair.text: Unknown agent: the builder and reviewer must be agents of the project
lane.refused.unknownPair.note: cw_lane join refused: its builder or reviewer isn't an agent of the project.

lane.refused.unknownReviewer.text: Unknown agent: the reviewer must be an agent of the project
lane.refused.unknownReviewer.note: cw_lane start refused: its reviewer isn't an agent of the project.

lane.refused.unknownReviewer.has.text: No agent "{name}" in {project}; this lane's reviewer is {reviewer}: leave reviewer out to keep it.
lane.refused.unknownReviewer.has.note: cw_lane start refused (HI-2273): it names a reviewer that is no agent of the project, and the builder's running lane has its reviewer.

lane.refused.unknownReviewer.none.text: No agent "{name}" in {project}; this lane has no reviewer yet: leave reviewer out, or name an agent of {project}.
lane.refused.unknownReviewer.none.note: cw_lane start refused (HI-2273): it names a reviewer that is no agent of the project, and the lane has none yet.

lane.refused.unknownReviewer.pool.text: No agent "{name}" in {project}; this lane is reviewed by the project's reviewer pool: leave reviewer out.
lane.refused.unknownReviewer.pool.note: cw_lane start refused (HI-2273): it names a reviewer that is no agent of the project, and the lane is reviewed by the pool.

lane.reorder.itsBranch.note: In place of {line}: where a put-back card's work stays, when its branch's name isn't known.

lane.reorder.putBackWhy.text: Put back by a lane reorder applied now ({by})
lane.reorder.putBackWhy.note: The reason recorded on a card put back by a reorder applied now (HI-1995), stored on the card's facts; {by} is who reordered.

lane.start.applied.text: Applied now: {card} is back in Todo (its work stays on {line}); the lane's cards are now in this order, and {builder} is told.
lane.start.applied.note: cw_lane start's note for a reorder applied now (HI-1995); {line} is the card's branch (or lane.reorder.itsBranch).

lane.start.carried.text: {builder}'s lane {lane} had just ended (all merged): started a new lane with its {what, select, brief {brief} name {name} other {brief and name}}; pass brief to change it.
lane.start.carried.note: cw_lane start's note (HI-2097, HI-2104): a list change raced its lane's end, so a new lane started with the ended one's brief, name, or both ({what}).

lane.start.leftOut.text: {cards} {n, plural, one {is} other {are}} already Done: left out.
lane.start.leftOut.note: cw_lane start's note (HI-2097): cards already Done, left out of a new lane; {n} is how many.

lane.start.queued.text: The list change is queued: it applies once {card} is Done, and you are told then.
lane.start.queued.note: cw_lane start's note (#1270): a list change while a card is in flight waits for that card ({card}) to be Done.

lane.start.stays.text: {cards} {n, plural, one {stays} other {stay}} on the lane, after the cards you listed: a builder's own cw_lane start adds or reorders cards, never takes one off (the Assistant or the user does).
lane.start.stays.note: cw_lane start's note (HI-2169): a builder's own start left cards of its lane out, and they are kept after its list; {n} is how many.

lane.state.abandoned.note: An abandoned lane's state (ended before its cards were Done).

lane.state.activeAllPassed.note: A running lane's state: every card passed, its merges remain.

lane.state.activeOn.note: A running lane's state: the card it is on.

lane.state.ended.note: An ended lane's state (every card Done).

lane.state.endedMerged.note: An ended lane's state, with its merge commit ({commit}).

lane.state.paused.note: A paused lane's state; {why} is why it waits ("paused, #412 is blocked").

lane.state.pausedRoundLimit.text: {card} waits for the user at its round limit
lane.state.pausedRoundLimit.note: Why a lane is paused, where nothing more is known: its card at its round limit waits for the user's answer.

lane.status.aCard.note: Where a lane waits on no particular card: put in place of {card} in the lines below.

lane.status.aDependency.note: Where the card a lane's next card waits for isn't known: put in place of {waitsFor}.

lane.status.anAgent.note: Where the agent whose hooks aren't arriving isn't known: put in place of {agent}.

lane.status.blocked.note: A lane waits: its card is blocked (the user's to unblock), no reason given.

lane.status.blockedWhy.note: A lane waits: its card is blocked; {why} is the card's blocked reason, as given.

lane.status.checkCopy.text: waiting for a check copy for {card}
lane.status.checkCopy.note: A lane waits for a check copy (a copy at the card's revision for its checks).

lane.status.fresh.failed.text: {agent}'s new conversation didn't start ({why}): retry it from the lane's row, or end the lane
lane.status.fresh.failed.note: An agent's new conversation for its lane (HI-2034) failed to launch; {why} is why, as recorded.

lane.status.fresh.failedBare.text: {agent}'s new conversation didn't start (its start failed): retry it from the lane's row, or end the lane
lane.status.fresh.failedBare.note: An agent's new conversation for its lane (HI-2034) failed to launch, with no reason recorded.

lane.status.fresh.timeout.text: {agent}'s new conversation didn't start (it wasn't free in time): retry it from the lane's row, or end the lane
lane.status.fresh.timeout.note: An agent owed a new conversation for its lane (HI-2034) wasn't free within the wait: no more automatic tries until the user retries it.

lane.status.fresh.uncertain.text: {agent}'s new conversation didn't start (Combwork closed as it started): retry it from the lane's row, or end the lane
lane.status.fresh.uncertain.note: An agent owed a new conversation (HI-2034) was being launched when Hive closed: never launched again by itself.

lane.status.fresh.waits.text: waiting: {agent} starts in a new conversation once it is free
lane.status.fresh.waits.note: An agent is owed a new conversation for its lane (HI-2034): Hive launches it once the agent is free.

lane.status.hold.note: A lane waits: its card is On Hold (a column name).

lane.status.hooks.note: A lane pauses while its builder's or reviewer's hooks aren't arriving (#1336): nothing is typed into that agent.

lane.status.itsAgent.note: Where the agent owed a new conversation isn't known by name: put in place of {agent}.

lane.status.itsBuilder.note: Where the lane's builder isn't known by name: put in place of {agent}.

lane.status.itsSlot.note: Where the slot being prepared isn't known by name: put in place of {slot}.

lane.status.lineUpdate.text: waiting: bringing the builder's branch up to date before {card}
lane.status.lineUpdate.note: A lane's next card waits while its builder's branch is brought up to date (§16.19.2).

lane.status.listChanges.note: A change of the lane's card list is queued: it applies once {card}, the card in flight, is Done.

lane.status.merging.note: A lane waits: its passed card is being merged.

lane.status.notMerged.note: A lane waits: its card passed but is not merged yet; a lane takes one card at a time (§16.11.2).

lane.status.preparing.note: A lane's slot is being prepared (warming, its setup or an install, #1446); {slot} is its name.

lane.status.reviewer.note: A lane waits: its card is in Review, or its design waits, and nobody reviews it yet.

lane.status.roundLimit.text: {card} reached the round limit: waiting for the user
lane.status.roundLimit.note: A lane waits: its card failed review as many times as the lane's rounds allow; the user decides (§16.11.4).

lane.status.slot.note: A lane started with no slot free waits for one to be lent to it (#1438).

lane.status.slotHeld.text: waiting for {slot}: {held, select, session {{agent}'s session is still in it} broker {a process still has a file or folder in it open: Windows Sandbox's broker ({broker}) is working in it{idle, select, yes {, with no Sandbox running} no {, with a Sandbox running} other {}}} other {a process still has a file or folder in it open}}
lane.status.slotHeld.note: HI-2466: a lane waiting for a slot, the only free one ({slot}) held: a session of the agent {agent} still runs in it, or (other) a process holds it. broker (HI-2467): a process holds it, and Windows Sandbox's broker ({broker}: its process name, such as WindowsSandboxServer) has the slot as its current folder; idle: yes, no Sandbox runs; no, one does; other, not known. Hive tries again until it is free.

lane.status.stale.note: A lane's card's pass no longer holds (its work changed since): it is submitted again.

lane.status.start.busy.text: {card} waits to start: {agent} is in a turn
lane.status.start.busy.note: A lane's next card isn't started yet (HI-2029): its builder is in a turn, or starting.

lane.status.start.dependencies.text: {card} waits to start: it waits for {waitsFor} to merge
lane.status.start.dependencies.note: A lane's next card waits for a card it depends on to be merged (HI-2129); {waitsFor} is that card's key.

lane.status.start.failed.text: {card} waits to start: {agent}'s last start failed
lane.status.start.failed.note: A lane's next card isn't started yet (HI-2029): Hive's last start of it on the builder failed.

lane.status.start.queued.text: {card} waits to start: a line of Combwork's is on its way to {agent}
lane.status.start.queued.note: A lane's next card isn't started yet (HI-2029): a line Hive types is on its way to the builder.

lane.status.start.refused.text: {card} waits to start: its start was refused for now; Combwork tries again
lane.status.start.refused.note: A lane's next card isn't started yet (HI-2029): Hive's start of it was refused for now, and is tried again.

lane.status.start.refusedHeld.text: {card} waits to start: its start was refused for now, {slot} still in use ({held, select, session {{heldBy}'s session is still in it} left {{heldBy}'s last run left {program}{more, plural, =0 {} other { and # more}} running in it} lastRun {{heldBy}'s last run there isn't known to have ended} broker {a process still has a file or folder in it open: Windows Sandbox's broker ({broker}) is working in it{idle, select, yes {, with no Sandbox running} no {, with a Sandbox running} other {}}} other {a process still has a file or folder in it open}}); Combwork tries again
lane.status.start.refusedHeld.note: A lane's next card isn't started yet (HI-2468): Hive's start of it was refused because its slot {slot} is still in use: a session of the agent {heldBy} still runs in it; left, the agent {heldBy}'s last run left programs running in it ({program}: the first one's name, such as node; {more}: how many more); lastRun, that run isn't known to have ended; or (broker) a process holds it, and Windows Sandbox's broker ({broker}: its process name) has the slot as its current folder, idle: yes, no Sandbox runs; no, one does; other, not known; or (other) a process holds it. Hive tries the start again.

lane.status.start.watching.text: {card} waits to start: {agent} is waiting on other work
lane.status.start.watching.note: A lane's next card isn't started yet (HI-2029): its builder waits on a watch of other cards.

lane.status.teamPause.note: The workspace's team is paused (before an update, HI-2081): nothing of a lane moves until it resumes.

lane.status.you.note: A lane waits: a request on its card waits for the user (For you).

lane.store.damaged.text: The lanes file is damaged and couldn't be set aside ({error}): it was left as it is
lane.store.damaged.note: lanes.json from before #1018 isn't JSON lanes and couldn't be renamed aside; {error} is the system's error.

lane.store.readFailed.note: The workspace's lanes.json from before #1018 couldn't be read to move it in (Windows holding it, no permission); {error} is the system's error. The next open tries again.

lane.tell.listChanged.text: Your lane's card list changed, as queued: its cards are now {cards}. cw_lane next names your next card.
lane.tell.listChanged.note: Delivered to a lane's builder once a queued change of its card list applies (#1270); {cards} is the list, in order.

lane.tell.reordered.text: Your lane was reordered now by {by}: {card} is back in Todo (its work stays on {line}): stop working on it. Its cards are now {cards}. cw_lane next names your next card.
lane.tell.reordered.note: Delivered to a lane's builder after a reorder applied now (HI-1995) put its card in flight back; {by} is who reordered it, {line} its branch (or lane.reorder.itsBranch).

lane.wait.hours.note: A lane's wait in hours ("6 h", "1.5 h").

lane.wait.minutes.note: A lane's wait in minutes ("90 min").

lane.warn.fresh.text: Warning: {items}: is it the card you meant? To put a new card on a lane, create it with cw_create_task's lane, never by its guessed key.
lane.warn.fresh.note: cw_lane start's safety net (HI-2167): a card in its list may be a guessed key; {items} are lane.warn.freshItem's.

lane.warn.freshItem.note: One card of a start's list made by someone else since the caller's turn began (HI-2167); {ago} in seconds. Joined with "; " into lane.warn.fresh's {items}.

lane.warn.shared.text: Warning: {items}. A card belongs to one lane: ask the Assistant or the user to take it out of one of them (a builder's own cw_lane start never takes a card off its lane).
lane.warn.shared.note: cw_lane start's warning (HI-1821, HI-2169): cards on two lanes; {items} are lane.warn.sharedItem's.

lane.warn.sharedItem.note: One card of a start's list another builder's running lane lists too (HI-1821); {lane} is that lane's id. Joined with "; " into lane.warn.shared's {items}.
